d:
Mahilaon ki suraksha ko lekar dilli pulis ne 2021 se ab tak rajdhani men 120 se 130 pink buth banae hain. inka maksad mahilaon ki shikayton ko sunna aur unhen jaruri madad muhaiya karana hai. lekin haliya dushkarm ki ghatnaon ke bad in buthon ki karyapranali aur mahilaon ki suraksha men unki bhumika par saval uth rahe hain.
Inki jamini sthiti janne ke lie hamne dilli ke purvi aur uttari ilakon men bane sat pink buthon ka jayja liya. kahin buth band pare the, to kahin mahila puliskarmi maujud nahin thin. kuchh buthon ke aaspas gandgi aur badhal vyavastha bhi najar aaee.
